facts.fact: CRAN rejected Starlink's application for a telecommunications service licence and spectrum on 23 March 2026, mainly because Starlink is wholly foreign owned against the 51% local ownership rule in Section 46 of the Communications Act.

CRAN dismissed all appeals against the Starlink rejection on 22 June 2026, saying the application remained non-compliant with ownership and control requirements; Starlink reportedly missed the 23 April appeal deadline.
In November 2024 CRAN issued a cease-and-desist order after finding Starlink operating without a licence, warned consumers against buying Starlink equipment and confiscated terminals from users.
